create_ate_solver: create an Adaptive Tsallis Entropy solver for approximate Nash equilibrium computation in nonsymmetric games
run_ate_gradients: run the ATE solver to compute exploitability gradients and Tsallis regularized exploitability estimates
run_cheap_gradients: run the cheap stochastic gradient variant of ATE solver using sampled columns for O(d) updates
test_solver_update_step: test the ATE solver's mirror descent or Euclidean projected gradient descent update step
review_solver_exploitability: review the ATE solver's exploitability computation using Tsallis entropy regularization
